findings.title: The gift relation turns into withheld reciprocity
findings.claim: The value word can carry a gift relation, and the earlier ingratitude image makes intense love newly legible as holding received benefit while breaking its return toward others or its source.
findings.mechanism: The focus gift carrier 100:8:3:2 meets the nominated ingratitude image at 100:6; the supplied withholding context at 70:21 then independently returns through the focus predicate's eli-sikilik facet, producing a relation of received benefit and blocked reciprocity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees an asymmetry inside the attachment: benefit is welcomed as an object of love while the movement that would pass it on is arrested.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the ordinary value and intensity reading and states only a contextual reciprocity implication; it does not claim that all love of good is ingratitude or that shadid must mean miserliness.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk source names the gift, withholding, and ingratitude roles, but its branch detail is legacy-unbound; the registered focus and context branch records support the bounded contact.
